title: Next Door
description: Ultimate Beat Battle Round 1 (Opus). A 2-step garage miniature in C# minor at 140 BPM. A synthetic singer is in the room with you while the party plays through the wall; at bar 5 the door opens. One 808 made monophonic from three choked voices; the same voice an octave down answers in the switch; GLASSHOUSE glass answers the hook.

tracks.description: The hook: synthetic vowel syllables sung on G#4, pitched per note with playbackRate; tape start at 0:00, tape stop at the end.

patterns.description: Hook bars 1-8 and 13-16; switch calls in 9-10; bar 8 stutter; bar 15 suspension bend; bar 16 tape stop.

tracks.description: The hook an octave down (slowed-tape voice): switch answers, six-beat spin-up riser, octave double under the final drop, closing "oo".
Inhale filling the silent last beat of bar 12, then the hook harmonised a third below in the final drop.
GM electric piano: rootless voice-led chords; 2-step stabs, held in the switch, eighth pulse into the gap.
Bars 1-4: the electric piano next door, cut at 4:3.
GM choir aahs: a human halo behind the synthetic voice.
GLASSHOUSE glass-hit at seven pitches: answers to the hook, a falling line in the switch, a counter-line in the final drop.
Reverse glass (two beats) into bar 5; prism impacts on 13:1 and on the final downbeat, slowing to half speed.
Bars 1-4: the 2-step beat heard through a wall, creeping closer, stopping dead on 4:3.

patterns.description: As next-door, but nothing from 4:3: the door opens.

tracks.description: 2-step kick (1 and the and-of-3, swung ghost and pickup on alternate bars); quarters in the build.

patterns.description: Quarter notes; beat 4 of bar 12 is silent.

tracks.description: Clap on 2 and 4, a snare flick into the switch, half-time on 3 in the switch.
Swung offbeat hats with rims answering the vocal; shaker in the switch; snare roll climbing an octave in the build.

patterns.description: Open hat at 0.75x speed as a crash on the drop downbeats.
Eighths, sixteenths, then thirty-seconds; each hit 1/2 semitone higher (playbackRate).

tracks.description: 808 voice 1 of 3 (round robin). Automation: choke, kick duck, section level.
808 voice 2 of 3 (round robin). Automation: choke, kick duck, section level.
808 voice 3 of 3 (round robin). Automation: choke, kick duck, section level.
